segments.text: both sons of a man and sons of a [great] man, the rich and the poor together!

verses.text: My mouth will speak wisdom, and a declaration of my heart, understanding.

verses.text: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will open up my riddle with the harp.

segments.text: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will open up my riddle with the harp.

verses.text: Why should I fear in the days of evil, the perversion [that] surrounds me [at] my heels,

verses.text: A brother surely cannot ransom a man, and he cannot give to God his redemption price.

verses.text: For costly [is] the ransom of their soul, and it shall cease forever,

verses.text: that he might live on forever, [and] not see the Pit.

verses.text: For he sees wise men die; the fool and the senseless one perish together, and they leave their wealth for others.

verses.text: Their inward thoughts [are] their homes forever, their dwelling places from generation to generation, they proclaimed over the lands their own names.

segments.text: Their inward thoughts [are] their homes forever, their dwelling places from generation to generation, they proclaimed over the lands their own names.

verses.text: And man in [his] wealth does not remain; he becomes like the beasts that perish.

verses.text: This [is] their path of folly for them, and after them in their sayings they took delight. Selah
